selected_outputs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise the supplied Living Atlas background only, preserving the approved dark painterly pale stone, black glass, aged brass material and symbolic four-theme composition. Preserve the ancient fractured relic pedestal only in bottommost 8% and weathered structure only within left/right 8% margins. No nodes, circles, dotted lines, connectors, routes, unlock states, nameplates, text, writing, icons, logos, buttons or UI of any kind. No characters, bosses, new geographic landmarks. Do not blur everything: peripheral material detail remains crisp; central calm negative space intentionally painted for overlay readability.
